gaps.prev_text: Bringing harmony to all who suffer.

cues.text: The purple spiral galaxy is now a glowing golden web of interconnected nodes. Scattered red diamonds mark points across the network. The map slowly fades into darkness.

beats.note: A glowing purple and white spiral galaxy spins slowly in the dark void of space.
The galaxy glitches, transforming into a glowing golden network of interconnected nodes and lines.
Red diamond markers appear at various points across the network.
The network map slowly begins to fade to black.
